proposals.before: Near the end of Zhao's reign the Xihe dependent chieftain Yijiuoru had mutinied with thousands; Fengshi had seized the staff and run him down.
proposals.after: Near the end of Emperor Zhao's reign the Xihe dependent chieftain Yijiuoru had mutinied with thousands; Fengshi had seized the staff and run him down.
proposals.reason: Chinese 昭帝末 refers to Emperor Zhao, not the state of Zhao; 'Zhao's reign' is misleading.

proposals.before: Ren Qianqiu's father Ren Gong had served Zhao's chancellor as investigator, cut down mutineer Shangguan Jie, taken a marquisate, and ended as Grand Master of ceremonies under Xuan.
proposals.after: Ren Qianqiu's father Ren Gong had served Emperor Zhao's chancellor as investigator, cut down mutineer Shangguan Jie, taken a marquisate, and ended as Grand Master of ceremonies under Xuan.
proposals.reason: Chinese 昭帝時 refers to Emperor Zhao; 'Zhao's chancellor' wrongly suggests the state of Zhao.

proposals.before: So Boyi was driven out, Mengzi the palace attendant was castrated, Crown Prince Sheng hanged himself, Qu Yuan drowned—the "Little Boy" ode and "Li sao" rose from such pain.
proposals.after: So Boqi was driven out, Mengzi the palace attendant was castrated, Crown Prince Sheng hanged himself, Qu Yuan drowned—the "Little Boy" ode and "Li sao" rose from such pain.
proposals.reason: Chinese 伯奇 is Boqi (the wronged son of Yin Jifu), not Boyi (伯夷).

proposals.before: Therefore Boyi was banished, Mengzi the Lu eunuch suffered castration, Sheng'er strangled with pheasant cord, Qu Yuan threw himself into the Xiang; the poem "Little Boy" was composed, the words of "Li sao" arose.
proposals.after: Therefore Boqi was banished, Mengzi suffered palace castration, Sheng'er strangled with pheasant cord, Qu Yuan threw himself into the Xiang; the poem "Little Boy" was composed, the words of "Li sao" arose.
proposals.reason: 伯奇 is Boqi, not Boyi; 孟子宮刑 does not state that he was a Lu eunuch.

proposals.before: Shen was the Lady of Handsome Fairness's younger brother; his conduct was meticulous. His severity inspired fear, and he never drew near to serve within the curtained chambers.
proposals.after: Shen was the Brilliant Companion's younger brother; his conduct was meticulous. His severity inspired fear, and he never drew near to serve within the curtained chambers.
proposals.reason: 昭儀 was earlier rendered Brilliant Companion for the same woman (Feng Yuan); 'Lady of Handsome Fairness' is an inconsistent alternate rendering.

proposals.before: Shen was the younger brother of the Lady of Handsome Fairness; his conduct was moreover careful and complete. Because of his severity he was feared, and in the end he could not draw near to attend within the curtained chambers.
proposals.after: Shen was the younger brother of the Brilliant Companion; his conduct was moreover careful and complete. Because of his severity he was feared, and in the end he could not draw near to attend within the curtained chambers.
proposals.reason: Same 昭儀 inconsistency as in the idiomatic field.

proposals.before: Let him bring Shen back to the capital to attend court at morning audience as a full marquis."
proposals.after: Let Shen return to the capital to attend court at morning audience as a full marquis."
proposals.reason: Imperative 其還參京師 means Shen is to return; 'Let him bring Shen' invents a wrong agent.

proposals.before: Bring Shen back to the capital to attend court as a full marquis."
proposals.after: Let Shen return to the capital and attend court as a full marquis."
proposals.reason: The idiomatic field retains the same invented agent as the literal; 其還參京師 makes Shen the subject who is to return.

decisions.reason: Focus unit 昭帝末 names Emperor Zhao at the end of his reign; 'Zhao's reign' wrongly suggests the state of Zhao. Adding 'Emperor' restores the temple-name referent without changing the rest of the sentence.
Focus unit 昭帝時以丞相征事 places Ren Gong's service in Emperor Zhao's time as chancellor's investigator; 'Zhao's chancellor' misreads 昭帝 as the polity Zhao.

decisions.after: So Boqi was driven out, Mengzi was castrated, Crown Prince Sheng hanged himself, Qu Yuan drowned—the "Little Boy" ode and "Li sao" rose from such pain.
decisions.reason: 伯奇 is Boqi, not Boyi (伯夷), so the proposed name fix is right; but 孟子宮刑 marks the castration punishment and does not call Mengzi a palace attendant, so that invented office must also be removed.
Focus unit 伯奇 is Boqi, not Boyi; 孟子宮刑 states only that Mengzi suffered palace castration and does not identify him as a Lu eunuch. The proposed literal repairs both errors.
Focus unit 昭儀 is the consort rank Brilliant Companion; 'Lady of Handsome Fairness' is the usual English for 婕妤 and misnames the rank here, so the repair restores the correct title.
Same focus unit 昭儀; the literal must match the consort rank Brilliant Companion rather than the 婕妤 title 'Lady of Handsome Fairness'.
Edict 其還參京師 is an imperative that Shen return to the capital; 'Let him bring Shen' invents a third-person agent the Chinese does not have.
The idiomatic field retained the same invented agent as the corrected literal; 其還參京師 makes Shen the subject who is to return.
